calibration_basis.note: All thresholds are calibrated on English. Danish is not calibrated.

classes.drift: right words, wandering offsets, low agreement everywhere (E08: offsets -62/-74/-82, agreement <=0.58)
classes.hop: clean content, a clean jump between blocks (E21: +40s; S03E02: +18/-15s; S03E05: -24s; S03E07: +22/+35s)
classes.wrong_content: agreement <0.65 at all offsets in all quarters (E14/E15/E16/E17/E20/E22/E23, E18/E19 backups)

cost_notes: The GPU and CPU workers ran at the same time during the sweep: the times are a ranking, not benchmarks. N100 numbers are missing.

toolchains.windows_gpu: MSYS2 UCRT64, Vulkan, AMD RX 6750 XT

detection_examples.E19_wrong_is_E20: the opening 'Don't forget, Greendale' = E20 Whisper verbatim; agreement vs E19 only 0.057
detection_examples.E20_file_is_E21: opens with the E21 diorama speech

metric.agreement: share of subtitle words found in the transcript within +/-2s (timing agreement)
metric.reference: whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo word times (DTW, 10ms) as ground truth

recommendation.cpu_N100: tiny.en-q5_1 or base.en-greedy (to be measured on N100)

small.en-q5_1-nomc.note: only E02+E04 run; -mc 0 makes no difference here

report: whisper sync/detection evaluation (52 episodes + 14 sweep configurations)

scope.episodes: Community S02+S03, Slow Horses S01 (52), Stormester S03 (4/8 transcribed)

sparse_samples.E02_cheap_models: all probes correct incl. tiny (tiny: more no-data rejections at k=1)
probe_guards: at least 40 transcript words in [pt-2, pt+32]
sparse_samples.recommendation: k=2 (2x30s per 10 min); k=3 misses cluster at discontinuities (informative)
sparse_samples.transcript_source: turbo words (upper bound; small deviation is small per sweep)

adaptive_escalation.design: disagreeing neighbouring probes (>5s) -> an extra probe in between, max depth 3, max 8 extra clips; then segments with the median offset
ladder: sequence match only on suspected swap
adaptive_escalation.status: tested 2026-09-15 on S02E21 (6 extra probes -> segments -0.5/+53/+41)

line_swap.design_from_pyc: synthetic swapped two-line cues; sequence matching after the median method gave 40% false positives
line_swap.needed: word times over suspected cues + sequence match; fits as L3 in the ladder

units.tokens_t_dtw: centiseconds (1/100 s), -1 = invalid (~10% of tokens, use offsets.from)

nonuniform_offsets.method: 8 healthy episodes x piecewise(6 blocks +-5..15s, seed offset-v1) / drift(2% progressive) / gap(5min middle section deleted); corruption on the SRT, fixture transcript shim, no new Whisper; 8 parallel workers

piecewise.root_cause: one boundary-straddling anchor per block boundary (a clip that covers the boundary measures the median of two offsets) triggered a thin-region veto of the whole plan; 55 clean anchors discarded
piecewise.fix: patch 0004: straddlers (value strictly between disagreeing neighbours) are dropped; wild values outside both are not dropped; the dense re-measurement before writing is unchanged

partial_1_of_8.cause: dense blocks (+8.1/+5.3s) are over-segmented into 8 regions; verification blind at ~1-2s

piecewise.pattern: anchor-region resync works; the veto rule was the fault, not a lack of transcription
